paired_http.scope: Full124 paired requests and30848 generated tokens per variant, including streaming and all16-request mixed rounds. Raw texts remain in each original report. Text equality is recorded, not substituted for the separate96-question quality suite. Stochastic text differences are expected and do not by themselves prove a regression; sequential timings are not a significance test.

limitations: Original outer exited 1; driver/coordinator result and final artifact reuse check absent.
Both original HTTP host receipts lack effective_host_settings; original host comparison cannot pass.
Saved HTTP rates are descriptive; sequential trials are not a statistical significance test.
Packaged Qwen3.5 source has not inherited this research run qualification.
